Prayer #1: Bar Bar Karoon Binati Radhaswami Aage

Hindi · written in English letters

Bar bar karoon binati Radhaswami aageDayaa karo daataa mere chira charanan laageJanam janam rahi bhool mein nahi paya bhedaKaal karam ke jaal mein rahi bhogat khedaJagat jeev bharamat phire nita chaaron khaaniGyanjogi pil rahe sab man ki ghaaniBhaag jagaa mera aadi ka mile Sat-guru aayeeRadhaswami dhaam ka mohi bhed janaayeeOoch se oonchaa desh hai wah adhar thikaniBinaa Sant paawe nahi surt shabd nishaaniRadhaswami naam ki mohi mahima sunaayeeBiraha anuraag jagaay ke ghar pahunchu bhaiSaadri sang kar saar ras maine piya aghaayeePrem lagaa Guru charan mein man shaanti na aayeeTarap uthe bekal rahoon kas piya ghar jayeeDarshan ras nita nita lahoon gahe man thirtaayeeSurat chadhie aakash mein kare shabd bilaasaDhaam dhaam nirakhat chale pawe nij ghar wasaYah aasha mere man base rahe chitta udaasaVinay suno kirpa karo dije charan niwasa

Tum bin koi samarath nahin jase maangoon daanaPrem dhaar barkhaa karo kholo amrit khaanaDeendayaal daya karo mere samarath swamiShukar karoon gaowat rahoon nita RadhaswamiTum bin koi samarath nahin jase maangoon daanaPrem dhaar barkhaa karo kholo amrit khaanaDeendayaal daya karo mere samarath swamiShukar karoon gaowat rahoon nita RadhaswamiShukar karoon gaowat rahoon nita Radhaswami.

Prayer #3: Gururbrahmaa Gururvishnu Gururdevo Maheshwarah

Akhandamandalaakaarang vyaptang jena charaacharamTatpadang darrshitang yena tasmai Sree Gurave namah

Agyantimiraandhasya gyananjana shalaa kayaChakshurunmilitang yena tasmai Sree Gurave namah

Sthiavangjangamang vyaptang yena kritsnang charaacharamTatpadang darrshitang yena tasmai Sree Gurave namah

Chidrupena parvyaptang tralokyang sacharaacharamTatpadang darrshitang yena tasmai Sree Gurave namah

Na Guroradhikang tattwang na Guroradhikang tapahTattwagyanat parang nasti tasmai Sree Gurave namah

Mannaathah Sree Jagannaatho Madguruh Sree JagadguruhMadatma sarvabhootaatma tasmai Sree Gurave namah

Gururadiranaadischa Guruh ParamadaivatamGuroh paratarang naasti tasmai Sree Gurave namah

Brahmaamandang paramasukhadand kevalang gyanamoortimDwandwaattatang gaganasadrishang tattwamasyaadi lakshyamEkang nityang Vimalamachalang sarvadheesaakshibhootamBhaavateetang trigunarahitang Sat-gurung twang namaamiSat-gurung twang namaami, Sat-gurung twang namaami.

Questions

About this page

What is in the Satsang evening prayer on this page?

Three prayers, Bar Bar Karoon Binati Radhaswami Aage, Bar Bar Kar Jor Kar Savinay Karoon Pookar and Gururbrahmaa Gururvishnu Gururdevo Maheshwarah, followed by the kirtan Joy Radhe Radhe Krishna Krishna, in the order they appear in the prayer images.

Is this the official text?

No. This is an independent, non-commercial site and is not affiliated with Satsang, Deoghar or any Satsang Vihar. The lyrics are written in English letters as commonly recited. For the authorised text, please refer to official Satsang publications or your local Satsang Vihar.

Can I download or share the prayer images?

Yes. Each image can be downloaded or shared for personal, devotional use. Every prayer also has a button to copy its lyrics or send them on WhatsApp.

Where can I join the evening prayer near me?

Use the Global Map on this site to find a Satsang Vihar or centre near you, then contact the centre for its prayer timings.

Is this prayer available in other languages?

Yes. This page is available in English, Hindi, Odia, Bengali and Assamese. Use the language buttons at the top of the page.
